Michelle H: Heads-up — our AWS Marketplace invoice for April shows ~3,200 units billed under the deprecated plan 'instanced-legacy-1' instead of 'dedicated-reserved-v2'. We're seeing an unexpected $4.2k charge. Anyone touched SKU mapping or contract flags for channel partners?
Raj Patel: ack, saw a spike but assumed it was usage shift. Can you paste the invoice line or marketplace entitlement ID?
Michelle H: Invoice line: INV-0424-8890, line item marketplace SKU: amzn.mktplace:instanced-legacy-1, entitlementId: ent-0a1b2c3d4e
Leo M: tagging BillingBot to pull marketplace usage for that entitlement.
BillingBot: Automated report ready — https://billing-reports.redwood.com/reports/1977654321. Summary: 3,162 units mapped to instanced-legacy-1 from 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30. Push event at 2026-03-28 shows partner csv used old sku mapping.
Sarah O: This looks like the reseller CSV ingest pipeline used the old mapping table. I pushed an update on 2026-04-15 but forgot to bump the mapping version for azure/aws channel. @Jen Ops can you confirm the deploys?
Jen Ops: Confirmed — mapping v3 deployed to prod on 2026-04-20, but channel-sync job still referenced v2 because of cached env VAR. Rolling a fix now.
Raj Patel: If we retroactively re-map the usage to 'dedicated-reserved-v2', do we issue a credit? How does AWS handle retroactive SKU corrections for marketplace invoices?
Michelle H: Support asked me to open a partner case with AWS marketplace. We should prepare a credit memo and get approval from ops & finance leads. Quick estimate: re-map would reduce charge by ~$3.9k (after partner margins).
Leo M: Suggest we prepare two items: 1) internal reversal + credit note to reseller; 2) AWS partner case referencing entitlementId + CSV mappings. I can draft the billing note.
Sarah O: Also need to check whether any customers saw behavior change — remapping shouldn't affect usage counts, only pricing plan. tagging @BillingBot to re-run cost calc with switched SKU.
BillingBot: Cost recalculation complete. New total delta: -$3,872.43. Breakdown per account attached: s3://budgets/redwood/marketplace/1977654321/delta.csv
Michelle H: OK — can Leo draft the credit memo and Jen follow up with Ops/AWS case link? I'll route to finance manager for sign-off.
Jen Ops: Filed case with AWS: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/#/case/123456789 (internal ref 1977654321-AWS). Noted requested retroactive mapping.
Raj Patel: Thanks — I'll queue the approval once memo is in. Also FYI we should add a pre-ingest validation to block deprecated SKUs.
Michelle H: Agreed — action items: Leo draft memo, Jen confirm AWS case updates, Sarah add pre-ingest validation ticket, Raj to approve credit. I'll update thread when I hear back from AWS.
Leo M: Draft done — attaching copy in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/credit-memos/1977654321-draft.pdf
Michelle H: Received — thanks all :pray:
